site_name: 46 Woodside Road, Wood Green, London, N22 5HT
description:
Lawful development: Proposed use.
The proposed development comprises the installation of 3 no. Velux rooflights to the existing roof of the dwellinghouse.

The proposed works constitute permitted development under Schedule 2, Part 1, Class C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), which permits other alterations to the roof of a dwellinghouse.

The proposed rooflights will not project more than 0.15 metres beyond the plane of the existing roof slope and will not extend above the highest part of the existing roof. The proposal therefore complies with the relevant limitations and conditions of Class C.

The property is an existing dwellinghouse and is not located within a Conservation Area. There is no change of use proposed and the works are limited solely to the installation of the three rooflights.

Accordingly, the proposed development benefits from permitted development rights and planning permission is not required. A Lawful Development Certificate should therefore be granted confirming the lawfulness of the proposed works.
